name: Chromatic Masjid
summary: A cobalt prayer hall, a square minaret, and a vermilion half-dome form one bold architectural mark.
why: The minaret joins the hall at x=37–38. The semicircular roof and doorway share x=57, the dome meets the hall exactly at y=52, and all architectural masses finish at y=71. A red half-dome occupies the right half of the same roof rather than adding a separate object.
risk: The semicircular dome is intentionally modern and graphic. Its Islamic identity relies on the paired minaret and arched doorway, especially at 24px.
sub1: One dome split into two flat planes
sub2: Square minaret and hall share one foundation
reasonToChoose: You want a bold modern mosque that stays simple in a launcher.
